baseline.description: Unmodified captured launch command and effective settings

admission-6.description: Only change the active-request cap; six full contexts are NOT guaranteed

mtp-off.description: Remove all speculative settings; automatic admission and cache allocation may change

mtp-shallow.description: One experimental factor: reduce draft depth to one step / two draft tokens

prefill-4096.description: Only change prefill chunk size to 4096

prefill-16384.description: Only change prefill chunk size to 16384

memory-088.description: Only change static memory fraction; high-risk, requires measured headroom and separate approval

metrics-on.description: Observability-only candidate; remeasure rather than mixing with original baseline
